name: OCG Ravine Ruler
description: Dragon Ruler remained a leading OCG strategy after the smaller Dragon Rulers were forbidden. Dragon Ravine loaded the Graveyard, while the Level 7 Dragons provided the materials for Rank 7 Xyz Summons.

defining_cards.name: Dragon Ravine
defining_cards.why: Dragon decks could discard a card to send a Dragon from the Deck to the Graveyard, setting up their next summon.

defining_cards.name: Tempest, Dragon Ruler of Storms
defining_cards.why: It supplied repeatable Level 7 material and could search a Dragon by discarding itself with another WIND monster.

defining_cards.name: Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos
defining_cards.why: This Level 7 Dragon could return from the Graveyard as Xyz material or trade two FIRE cards for removal.

defining_cards.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack
defining_cards.why: Two Level 7 Dragon Rulers became a threat that generated Tokens for protection, removal and later summons.

defining_cards.name: Tidal, Dragon Ruler of Waterfalls
defining_cards.why: This Level 7 Dragon could revive itself as Xyz Material or discard with another WATER monster to send a monster from the Deck to the Graveyard.

other_deck_samples.relationship: Road of the King illustrates its 2013-11-01 to 2014-01-31 OCG tournament review with these decklists. The dates and placements of the individual examples are unspecified. Counts cover positively identified cards legal in the snapshot.
